card.name: Sentence joins in narrative prose
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or punctuation (period, comma, was, were, using, to, a) right after a subject in ordinary descriptive or story prose. It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Sentence-end period
modes.description: A period closing a short sentence about a person or thing in narrative text.

modes.label: Verb after subject
modes.description: A linking or helping verb such as was, were or using right after the subject.
modes.example: It<< was>> incorporated as a village in 18

modes.label: Joiner in a list or phrase
modes.description: A comma or a word like to or a that continues a descriptive phrase.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in everyday descriptive writing, such as the verb after a subject or a sentence-ending period.
